data.name: chetan keskar
data.player_statement:
A complete player, chetan keskar has made a big mark in cricket. With 44 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 40, with an average of 7.21 and a quick strike rate of 80.86. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 5 sixes and 18 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 13.0 overs, taking 8 wickets at an economy rate of 10.38. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
